## Commands
Everything runs from the repository root (`code/` in the delivery) with `BT_DATA` (raw data) and `BT_RESULTS` (raw per-pair results, default `/hutian/results`; not in the repository, they are large) set; no network after the download. Seeds: `--seed 0` everywhere; replicates use `np.random.default_rng([seed, tag, rep])`. Times are wall-clock on shared CPUs (one core unless stated).

| step | command | produces (in `$BT_RESULTS`) | time |
|---|---|---|---|
| core fragility, every unit | `scripts/run_core_all.sh 500 20` (Arena-55k, Arena single-turn, 17 LLM judges, MT-Bench human / GPT-4 / matched; then `scripts/run_core_nba.sh` for the 69 NBA seasons 1947-2015) | `core/<unit>.parquet` (k\*, z, Q per pair and family), `.null.parquet`, `.models.parquet` | Arena-55k ~14 min, Arena units ~1 h on 4 cores in total, NBA ~1.5 h |
| bootstrap refresh (only if `Prepared` changes) | `scripts/01b_refresh_boot.py UNIT...` | rewrites the bootstrap columns | minutes |
| random baselines | `scripts/02_random.py UNIT` | `random/<unit>.parquet`, `.eqbudget.parquet` | seconds to 6 min |
| CI separation of published ranks | `scripts/02b_ci.py UNIT` (`scripts/run_ci_random.sh` runs 02b and 02 for the remaining units) | `ci/<unit>.pairs.parquet`, `.models.parquet` | seconds to minutes |
| search validity: exact (exhaustive) anchors, LP candidate | `scripts/03_search_validity.py` | `search/tiny_exact.parquet`, `search/lp_sandwich.parquet` | ~1 h |
| synthetic BT checks (all rows marked synthetic) | `scripts/04_synthetic.py`, `scripts/04b_synthetic_pflip.py` | `synthetic/*.parquet` | ~5 min |
